last_assistant_message:
`add` is called in `main.py` and `tests/test_ops.py`.

The failing test was `test_divide`. `divide` used `//`, so `divide(7, 2)` returned 3 instead of 3.5. I changed it to `/` in `calc/ops.py`, and `python -m unittest -q` now passes (3 tests). I also created `NOTES.md` with the line "divide uses true division".
